The affixes क्रु and क्लुकन come in the sense of 'agent having such a habit etc.' after the verb भी 'to fear'.

Terms: क्रु and क्लुकन

इ is substituted for the ई of भी before a सार्वधातुक affix beginning with a consonant and having an indicatory क् or ङ्।

Terms: कित् and ङित्

The augment षुक् is added to the root भी before the affix णि when fear is caused immediately owing to the agent of the Causative.

Terms: षुक् augment
